t: Frogtape Delicate Surface 60-Day Masking Tape delivers sharp, clean paint lines with minimal effort. Ideal for professional decorating and finishing work and suitable for delicate, freshly painted, or laminated surfaces. Designed with advanced PaintBlock Technology, it prevents paint bleed for a crisp edge every time. The low-adhesion washi paper backing ensures safe use on delicate or freshly painted surfaces, coated wallpapers, and decorative finishes. UV-resistant and suitable for indoor applications, it removes cleanly for up to 60 days when stored between 20–30°C. Trusted by trade professionals for precision and reliability. Always test first, especially with tricky surfaces or solvent-based paints. For best results, peel off while paint is still wet for super sharp paint lines.
b: For Use on Freshly Painted Surfaces, Most Wallpapers & Newly Plastered Walls
